items.title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
items.authors: Travis Davies, Wentao Ma, Lihao Guo, Tengfei Ma, Xiaowen Chang, Jiafeng Xu, Shilong Wang, Yiqi Deng, Shaowen He, Xiaoqi Li, Qian Zhu, Ran Cheng, Hao Dong
items.abstract: Given a robot’s actions, PrimeSim predicts what happens next across three synchronized camera views. It was trained on 30,110 hours of demonstrations from 22 robot platforms.
items.mediaDescription: A PrimeSim-generated robot rollout from three synchronized camera views.

items.title: PRIME W0: Physical Priors from World Models for Embodied Manipulation
items.authors: Huabin Peng, Fagang Jin, Yancong Wei, Tengfei Ma, Chuhang Liu, Chao Yu, Liqing Chen
items.abstract: PRIME W0 uses a world model to predict a visual subgoal. The policy combines that prediction with the robot’s recent observations to choose its next action.
items.mediaDescription: Two physical robot arms manipulate a cloth in a Lumos Robotics demonstration.
